collection.description: Collection of tales and characters inspired by the Brothers Grimm.

info.name: Marlinchen
info.ability: Each night, choose a dead player and give them Bones. When a player with Bones returns to life, learn their real character.

info.name: El Padre del Enebro
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and learn whether they died by an ability or execution.

info.name: El Archivero
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and learn whether they have ever used their ability this game.

info.name: El Pájaro del Enebro
info.ability: Once per game, choose a dead player with Bones and resurrect them; then you die. If there is no valid target, keep the use.

info.name: La Madre bajo el Enebro
info.ability: When you die, choose a player: they cannot die the next night, but their vote does not count the following day.

effects.prompt: Cuando mueres, eliges a un jugador: no puede morir durante la noche siguiente, pero su voto no cuenta durante el día posterior.

info.name: El Orfebre
info.ability: Once per game, give a player a Chain. Cancel the first death that reaches them and remove the Chain; while held, their vote does not count.

effects.prompt: Una vez por partida entregas una Cadena a un jugador. La primera muerte que fuera a alcanzarlo se cancela y la Cadena se retira; mientras la conserve, su voto no cuenta.

info.name: El Zapatero de los Zapatos Rojos
info.ability: Once per game, remove an exclusion or speaking, voting, or nomination restriction from a player and take it for the same duration.

effects.prompt: Una vez por partida retiras de un jugador una exclusión o restricción de hablar, votar o nominar y la asumes durante el mismo plazo.

info.name: Stepmother
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and kill them.
info.lore: Cinderella's father's second wife and the mother of two daughters fair of face but vile of heart. She takes away Cinderella's clothes, sends her to the kitchen, scatters lentils in the ashes, and makes a promise about the festival only to break it; later she supplies the knife with which her daughters try to manufacture a bride.

cues.body: The Stepmother chooses a player. Kill them unless a protection intercepts the death.
The Stepmother chooses a player. Kill them unless a protection intercepts the death.

info.name: La Cocinera del Guiso
info.ability: Each night, if the Stepmother killed a player, learn who it was. If the Stepmother dies, lose this ability.

info.name: Shaman
info.ability: Once per game, at night, choose another dead player: you become their real character and adopt their current alignment.
